# NYDFS Industry Letter, Cybersecurity Risks Arising from Artificial Intelligence

- Source: <https://www.dfs.ny.gov/industry-guidance/industry-letters/il20241016-cyber-risks-ai-and-strategies-combat-related-risks>
- Version used: 2024-10-16
- Type: Supervisory guidance
- Access: public
- Checked: 2026-10-14

| Control | What it covers | Checklist items | How we checked |
|---|---|---|---|
| Access controls | Least privilege and access review apply to AI | [ACC-01](../checklist.md#acc-01) | verified |
| Data management | Inventory of all systems that use or rely on AI; Dispose of NPI no longer needed, including NPI used for AI; Data minimization | [CHG-01](../checklist.md#chg-01), [DAT-01](../checklist.md#dat-01), [DAT-02](../checklist.md#dat-02) | verified |
| Monitoring | Monitor AI tool use for unusual query behaviour; Monitor user activity and AI tool use | [ACT-03](../checklist.md#act-03), [RET-01](../checklist.md#ret-01) | verified |
| Risk assessments | Incident and continuity plans should address AI-related events | [INC-02](../checklist.md#inc-02) | verified |
| TPSP and vendor management | Diligence on third parties' AI | [SUB-01](../checklist.md#sub-01) | verified |
| Training | When human review must be part of verification | [HUM-01](../checklist.md#hum-01) | verified |
